text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Trainers!
This month marks the 3rd race of the "L'Arc Representative Exchange Race"!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
We'll hold a press conference before the race.
To announce that you're going for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe again this year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...No matter the endeavor,
public interest naturally wanes
once it enters its second or third year.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I will not let our expectations of you all fade.
—I have also prepared an interesting initiative.”

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you show off to your heart's content that day.
Show them your true potential.
